name: jetson-sensevoice-c64
description: Copy of jetson-sensevoice with the admission ceiling raised from 8 to 64, for the orin-nano (J3011) / orin-nx (J4012) concurrency-ceiling sweep (bench/asr_bench/DISPATCH.md). Same execution_policy (serialized, single TensorRT execution context) — this only changes how many callers may queue instead of taking a 429.
